description: This file sets up and runs an AI-powered conversational bot using various services (STT, TTS, LLM) with a pipeline architecture, including transport configuration, event handling, and session management.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds the context messages for the language model.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs user and assistant aggregators with shared context.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the processing pipeline for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a task with a pipeline and its parameters.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Transport parameters for WebSocket via FastAPI.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Represents a frame for running LLM tasks.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and executes the bot pipeline with given transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the bot.
